title: Outcast
paragraphs: “Well, I guess… it looks like you managed to rescue the hostages over there. But why are you here?”

“Ah… well, it seems the Queen of Melromarc is quite a stubborn one. And to make matters worse, these girls have been meticulously branded with slave marks, so it looks like they can’t leave the building. We’re using Magic to suppress the marks so they don’t activate, though.”

That’s quite thorough. That’s true… Since the Portal skill requires the target’s permission to be drawn in, you have to use slave marks or similar methods to render them unable to resist—that’s the exception. So, does that mean they forcibly enslaved the queens and carried them off? Trash—enslaving his own wife and Finacée like that—he’ll stop at nothing.
“…Lord Iwatani, thank you so very much for saving us this time.”
“Don’t worry about it. We’re allies, after all, and we were attacked by despicable terrorists. I can’t very well complain.”
Father spoke words of forgiveness regarding the queen’s apology. I’m relieved to have confirmed my Finacée’s safety as well. Fiancée is being protected, riding on Sakura-chan’s back.
“Elmelo is leading the others in evacuating the rest of the group outside the building right now. Elmelo and the others will be here soon, too.”
“Well, we’ve rescued the hostages. Don’t think you can keep manipulating Motoyasu-kun and fighting forever.”
That Trash just kept glaring at us with a completely unflappable expression.

“Aultcray… I can’t say I don’t understand why you’re angry about losing Malty. But Malty’s death was your own doing—yours included… Stop piling up more sins. What about Melty, who’s still alive right now?!”
The Queen tried to reason with that Trash. As if to drive the point home, she then showed him Tiger Guy and Big Sister she’d brought along.
“If you look at this child, surely you’ll understand? Times have changed. I understand your feelings of resentment… but let’s put an end to this.”
“So the plan is to have Atla meet him, right? Atla.”
“It seems so… That person has an aura very similar to my brother’s.”
The Tiger Guy and Big Sister also join in, addressing Trash.
“You’re getting too cocky just because you rescued a hostage. Mirellia, listen to me.”
Trash ignores us and walks toward the queen.

“Soon, we’ll have the Spear Hero—who killed Malty—kill the Shield Hero, and then, once the Spear Hero is completely exhausted, we’ll join forces to finish him off. That way, we’ll defeat all those responsible for the waves that are plunging the world into crisis, and peace will reign.”
“Nonsense… The theory that the Shield Hero is the mastermind behind the waves, as written in the Three Heroes Church’s scriptures, is simply not something one can believe.”

That’s exactly what’s written in the Three Heroes Church’s scripture, isn’t it? It’s a ridiculous story—that only the Three Heroes Church can survive the end-of-the-world wave by joining forces to kill the Shield Demon King at the time of the Holy War, when the world ends. It seems they tried to make us kill Father because they were attempting to reenact the events described in that scripture.

Father from the first world once remarked that every religion seems to have similar apocalyptic beliefs. Come to think of it, I recall hearing that even in my world, extremist religions hold similar ideas—the kind that claim only their own followers can survive.
“Either way, the crime of killing Malty is unforgivable. I won’t rest until I make him pay, even if I have to risk my own life!”

With that, Trash approached the Queen, and she glared back at him, refusing to back down. I wonder if they’ll be able to talk this out? Even the pigs don’t seem willing to step in this time… I suppose that means they trust Trash? Just as Trash reached the very front of the Queen, right in front of her bodyguard Éclair—!
“Danger!”
The tiger girl noticed and warned them. A flash of light burst from behind Trash for just an instant.
It came from a spot a little ways away in this room! Was that an attack aimed at Trash!? Who could it be!?
Just as my gaze turned toward the sniper, a voice rang out.
“Huh!?”
Thud! The Queen shoved Trash aside, taking that single beam of light to her chest.
“No way!?”

Even Éclair, who was nearby, and everyone else were too slow to react to that split-second event. I, too, was a little far away because I’d been fighting with Father. I was too late to rush over. That’s how fleeting the whole thing was.
“Ah…”

Trash, who had plopped down on his butt with a thud, glanced toward the sniper’s position, then immediately turned back to face the Queen. A hole had been blown through her chest, and she collapsed right there.
“Mi, Mirellia! What the hell do you think you’re doing, you bastardaaaaaaaaaa! ”
The Trash yells this at the sniper. The sniper appears to be a guy wearing a robe.

“Hmph. Did you really think I didn’t know what you were up to? Even though we went out of our way to set things up so you could fight more easily. You took your sweet time getting things going. Well… if I’ve weakened him this much, I guess that’s good enough.”
Hearing that voice, I furrowed my brow. As if he’d been waiting for his moment, the guy in the robe took it off, revealing his true form. Trash shouted the guy’s name.
“Taktoooooo!”
And there, standing with his face contorted in rage, was Takt—who should have already been dealt with in this loop.
“…Ort, Clay… Guh…”
Trash hurried over to the Queen and scooped her up. But the Queen was coughing up blood.
“Don’t speak! Mirellia! The wound is—ugh…”
There was a hole in her chest, and even with first aid, it was doubtful she would survive.
“Queen!”
Éclair rushed over and pointed her sword at Takt as if to shield the Queen.
“Mother!”
“Mel-chan!”
Since her finacée was leaning over Sakura-chan’s shoulder to get closer, Sakura-chan moved closer to the Queen.
“Mother! Mother! Stay with us!”
“S-someone! Help her!”
Trash cries out for help.
“Got it!”
Without a moment’s hesitation, Father rushed over first and began casting a healing Magic spell on the Queen.
“You—no! Please!”
Trash furrowed his brow at first, but now he’s watching Father’s Magic with the look of someone clinging to a straw. After all, healing magic is Father’s specialty.
However, even his healing magic has its limits. If it could heal any wound, the Tiger Girl wouldn’t have… died. And the dead cannot be brought back to life.
“Too bad! Don’t think you’ll recover that easily. While I’m at it, I’ll kill you too!”
With that, Takt… raises his sword, preparing to launch a follow-up attack on Trash and Father.
“Takt! You—”
Instinctively, I raised my spear toward Takt—
“Oops, Spear Hero! Can’t you see this? If you try anything stupid, my minions will smash even more eggs than the ones right here!”
As if it were the most natural thing in the world, Takt has wrapped Filolial-sama’s eggs all over his body.
“Ugh…”

“Haha! See? It works like a charm! What do you mean ‘it doesn’t work,’ you idiot! Of course it works! So much for being the ‘Wise King of Wisdom.’ My brain’s way better than yours! Don’t you know the saying, ‘Seeing is believing’?”
Takt said this as if he were mocking Trash. It seems Takt and Trash were in cahoots behind the scenes.
“I won’t let you!”
Just as Rival was about to attack Takt, Takt interrupted the attack and leaped far back.
“You’re all coming out in droves! You lot! Let’s take care of them quickly! The only dangerous one is the Spear Hero anyway!”
“‘Boo-boo!’”
“Ah, Nelshen. You go take out that dragon over there—the one that took over the place.”
“Boo-boo!”
At this point, the pig—the former representative of Shieldfreeden who was among Takt’s entourage—stepped forward, puffed out his chest, and let out some kind of cry.
“Takt… why are you here!?”
Father says to Takt with a bewildered expression.
“…It’s a homunculus. Someone close to Takt managed to secure his soul. Then, someone knowledgeable about homunculi implanted it into a replica body and revived him.”
“Boo-boo-boo!”

Next to Takt, a guy in a white lab coat is standing there with his chest puffed out. I want to kill him, but he’s meticulously covered his entire body with Filolial-sama’s eggs. These guys…! My murderous intent has reached its limit!

“That’s the deal! Seriously, they’re treating us like we’re the root of all this trouble! You guys are the ones at fault! It’s because of you that we’ve been pushed into the shadows! That’s why you have to take responsibility and reveal the truth!”
Takt is letting loose with a furious tirade. Ugh… If they hadn’t taken Filolial-sama’s eggs hostage, this situation wouldn’t have happened…
“To think they could do something like that…”
“Alchemists really have no limits… It makes me sick!”
Panda is baring his claws and getting into a fighting stance.
“You’ve got to give it your all too, Sir Knight! If we lose here, everything’s ruined!”
“I know!”
“Whoa, can’t you punks even see this? Huh?”
Takt is flaunting a familiar sword with that familiar, arrogant attitude—one that looks all too familiar to me. That’s…
“—It’s a Sacred Weapon of the Sword!”

Rival says this upon seeing the sword Takt is holding. …It seems that even in this playthrough, Ren was killed by Takt. One of the mysteries has been solved. The reason Ren didn’t come to Cal Mira Island was because he’d already been killed by Takt.
“Of course I’ve got more up my sleeve! I may’ve been beaten last time, but I’m the strongest hero! This time, I’ll make sure you all pay the price!”
“So Ren is…”
Trash shakes his head at Father’s words. Huh? Does that gesture mean Ren is still alive? But his expression doesn’t look good.
“I do feel sorry for the Sword Hero. But I told myself it was all for the sake of revenge. However…”
It seems Ren is still alive—he just had his weapon taken from him. That’s a relief.
“Aultcray! You call yourself the Wise King of Wisdom—stop hiding that staff and hand it over already! I’ll put it to good use!”
“Who would ever hand it over to Trash like you!”
Trash yells at Takt, his hostility plain to see. Father watches Trash and Takt while tending to the queen’s wounds. Trash… looking extremely displeased, answered while cradling the queen.
“…It’s true that I’m prepared to use any means necessary to kill the Shield and the Spear… but not if my wife and Melty are dragged into this. Moreover…”
Trash then turned his gaze toward the Tiger Guy’s sister and wore a pained expression.
“You lot are the ones who killed Malty! If I could’ve killed you right here, that would’ve been fine! But—”
“Guh… Guh…”
This scene reminds me once again of the first world. Back then… the Queen died after being struck by Takt’s deadly blade, didn’t she?
“The Love Hunter commands—”
As he began chanting to unleash a dispel spell on Takt—
“So what are you trying to pull here! Can’t you see this!?”
With a *crack*, Takt smashed the egg. *Ggyyaaah!* *Oh no!* The incantation was interrupted.
“…Motoyasu, help me! I can’t heal him all by myself! Hurry!”
“O-okay!”
Back then, we didn’t know how to enhance our weapons, and there were limits to what we could do with Magic. Above all, Father had suffered life-threatening injuries.
But… if we join forces now, we should be able to save even a dying queen!
I despise this Trash and have him on my list of people to kill, but the Queen is a different matter. That’s why I’ll give it my all, too. After all, I do have a knack for healing Magic.
“Father, we need to coordinate our efforts to treat her. I’ll cast a powerful spell to purge the curse, so you use healing Magic to seal the wounds.”
“I know.”

Working in sync with Father, I’ll cast “Liberation Curse Recovery X.” After all, the weapon Takt is using is still a hero’s weapon, even if it’s rusted. It’s powerful, no matter what. There are many things even holy water can’t heal, and we weren’t able to treat the Queen of the First World in time either.
But little by little, the curse is losing its potency. The fact that it’s only weakening now that I’m giving it my all… just how powerful is this curse?!
“That’s why I told you not to do it! The fact that they’re all gathered in one spot means you’re supposed to do it, right?!”
Just as Takt raised his sword to attack us, Éclair and the others took up defensive positions to protect us.
“Bubuuu”

A pig—apparently the former representative of Shieldfreeden—who was standing near Takt took a step forward and began to transform. If I recall correctly, he’s capable of transforming into the form of Aotatsu.

That pig lunged at Rival. With a single swing, a massive dragon’s arm emerged, attempting to strike Rival. It seems the transformation is limited to just part of its body—and while it’s large, it’s designed so as not to hinder its movement indoors. How presumptuous of Takt and that pig to act this way!
